status: validator implemented and canonical index passes
behavior: Standard-library read-only CLI, default canonical path and optional --index argument.
Validates schema fields, source provenance/access dates/status, exact raw labels and locator context.
Rejects duplicate IDs within source/observation/topic namespaces, duplicate source+locator pairs, dangling source/observation/topic refs and duplicate canonical routes.
Requires explicit verified evidence flag for alias_of/same_as/equivalent; derives no equivalences.
Requires exhaustive false and no substantive credit statement; computes inventory counts at runtime.
Gracefully reports malformed JSON/fields and exits nonzero on failure.

tests.name: dangling source
errors: Observation O1: dangling or missing source_id

tests.name: dangling evidence
errors: Topic T1: evidence must be included in source_observation_ids

tests.name: equivalence without verified evidence flag
errors: Topic T1.relationships[0]: equivalence requires evidence_status verified

tests.name: malformed relationship and dangling topic handled without crash
errors: Topic T1.relationships[0]: dangling or missing target

tests.name: missing zero-credit statement
errors: coverage.counting_note must state "no substantive credit" (or zero substantive credit)

limits: Structural validity is not factual/source verification, current legal classification, ancestry, human approval or exhaustive enumeration.
Verified flag is declared evidence status, not independent proof of equivalence.
No site changes, dependency installs, Git mutations or shared-record edits.
No substantive500 credit; inventory tooling only.
